title: Right-now elicitation guidance for coding agents
description:
Coding agents need lightweight, always-current awareness of board state without opening every issue. This initiative establishes guidance for when and how agents should surface right-now summaries — especially via compaction hooks — and clarifies the two operating modes.

## Product rule (Ryan 2026-09-09)

**Compaction-hook injection** must deliver a **whole-project WIP summary** (general board awareness), not a pinned-issue-scoped summary.

When an agent runs `kbs now` (or `kbs right-now`) on its own initiative, it may scope to its own work for focused WIP.

Agents must understand both modes:
1. **Compaction hooks** — whole-project WIP (board-wide awareness after context loss)
2. **On-demand `kbs now`** — agent may scope to its own assigned/in-progress work for focused WIP

Compaction should be followed by whole-project WIP so the agent regains general board context, not just the issue it was pinned to.
